summary: The comment argues against cutting the E-Rate program, citing its importance as a major funding source for schools and libraries.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate will reduce funding for schools and libraries
claims.evidence_quote: The E-Rate program, which helps schools and libraries obtain affordable internet access and network equipment, is the fifth-largest funding stream for schools nationwide. Over the past four years, E-Rate has provided more than $471 million in assistance to Illinois schools and libraries.
